_note: Allocation ledger for Panel animations. Every animation has a stable, NAMESPACED id `<namespace>:<name>`. `core:*` is the reserved well-known block implemented in web/dash/motion.css (one `@keyframes mo-<name>` + `.mo-<name>` class each), loaded once by dashboard.html so it resolves on every surface. This is the motion analog of protocol.json: core defines the reserved block, and anyone else — a module, a person, or the agent — allocates within their OWN namespace. A module never redefines a shared keyframe; it reuses core:* or mints its own.
principle: Motion encodes a fact, never decoration. Every id maps to one meaning; if a proposed animation can't name the fact it shows, it doesn't ship. Living state may loop (spin/shimmer/pulse/flow-while-active); discrete events play once and settle (pop/rise/finite flow).

allocation.scheme: id = `<namespace>:<name>`. The name is a stable handle — retune the motion freely, but never rename/renumber an id (references break).
allocation.namespaces: core = this reserved file. Every module owns the namespace equal to its module.json `name` (git-manager:*, release-manager:*). A person or agent owns any namespace they coin. You may mint any name inside YOUR namespace at any time — no central sign-off, no collisions across namespaces.
allocation.reference: consumers declare intent in module.json `animations: {uses, owns}`. `uses` = core:* ids reused (physical class .mo-<name>). `owns` = ids in the module's own namespace, implemented in that module's chatAsset.css.
allocation.promote: when the SAME motion is reused across ≥2 namespaces, it graduates into core:* — added here as a new reserved primitive + `.mo-<name>` in motion.css, and each prior owner flips its `owns` entry to a `uses` of the new core id. This is the reuse-opportunity ('fırsat') trigger; it is small, reversible, in-plan work — the agent performs it autonomously when it spots the duplication.
allocation.css_map: core:<name> ↔ @keyframes mo-<name> + .mo-<name> (params on --mo-*). Owned ids keep their existing module classes; the id is the registry identity, the class is the CSS handle.

primitives.means: this just appeared / landed — a point event
a new item entered the view
a packet is transferring along a track
primitives.loops: infinite while active, or a finite count for one send
primitives.needs: a position:relative track + an absolutely-placed packet the caller styles
primitives.note: headline cross-namespace primitive: the Pulse git-rail transfer and the git push CARD are now the same motion.

owned._note: Single-namespace bespoke motions — allocated in their owner's namespace, implemented in the owner's own CSS, NOT reserved. Listed for visibility so the exclusion is a decision. Promotes to core:* only on ≥2-namespace reuse.
